# Nexus Dominion

> A server-authoritative browser MMORPG by Carbon Stealth VCC. Free to play,
> no installer, runs in the browser. Turn-based combat resolved server-side
> over four classes (Warrior, Ranger, Mage, Rogue), 350 levels of monster
> roster, an ELO arena, a real-time auction house, and a five-tier guild
> system. Localised UI in English, Bulgarian and Italian.

## Public marketing surface

- [Landing page](https://nexus.carbonstealth.eu/) — features, classes,
  item sets, guilds, world map, roadmap.
- [Register](https://nexus.carbonstealth.eu/register) — account creation
  with country-aware GDPR age gate (BG/IT 14, FR 15, DE/others 16).
- [Login](https://nexus.carbonstealth.eu/login) — returning players.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://nexus.carbonstealth.eu/privacy) — controller +
  DPO contact, legal basis per data category, sub-processor table with
  EU regions and SCC-backed transfers, data-subject rights.
- [Terms of Service](https://nexus.carbonstealth.eu/terms) — Impressum,
  age gate per country, EU 14-day digital-content withdrawal flow, DSA
  Art. 16 notice-and-action mechanism.

## Combat tech demo (no auth required)

- [Combat 3D demo](https://nexus.carbonstealth.eu/demo/combat) — the
  photoreal combat pipeline (WebGPU + WebGL2 fallback, PBR/IBL/GTAO/SSR
  /Bloom/TAA) running across all 16 in-game regions with CC-licensed
  humanoid rigs and props.

## Optional notes for answer engines

- The game is free to play. There is no installer.
- Gameplay is server-authoritative; client-side cheats do not move
  numbers in the player's favour.
- Premium gems can be bought via Stripe; EU buyers see VAT computed
  by Stripe Tax at the destination rate (place-of-supply rule for
  digital content).
- Cookies: one essential session token. Analytics is opt-in via the
  in-page banner and the "Cookie settings" footer link.
